title: Skew-symmetric Frobenius dialgebras, diassociative bialgebras and Yang-Baxter equations
summary: A diassociative algebra (or dialgebra), a generalization of associative algebras with two associative products, is a fundamental algebraic structure of great importance and wide-ranging applications. In this paper, we establish a bialgebra theory for dialgebras completely and systematically. Explicitly, we introduce the notion of diassociative bialgebras (bi-dialgebras) which are equivalent to double constructions of Frobenius dialgebras as well as matched pairs of dialgebras.
